name: BayCon
blurb: The San Francisco Bay Area's science fiction and fantasy convention since 1982; its 2027 edition doubles as the rotating Westercon 79.

picks: The Kitchen Witch; herbalism and herb lore
Digital lifestyle host, Otaku Patrol founder

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'JULY 2-5, 2027 - SANTA CLARA MARRIOTT'; page title 'BayCon 2027 / Westercon 79 | Night City Rising'; guest page headed 'BAYCON 42' (2027 is BayCon's 42nd year)

notes: Branded this cycle as 'BayCon 2027 / Westercon 79' (its 42nd year) since the rotating Westercon is combined with it, matching the seed note; Westercon 78 (2026) would already have run (BayCon is traditionally around Memorial Day weekend) and is before the research window, so only the confirmed July 2-5, 2027 edition is listed. Guests of Honor page lists 5 real guests (#1-#5); #0 and #6 are the nav bar and a repeated section banner and were skipped. Jenay Marontate ('The Kitchen Witch', an herbalist) doesn't fit any defined guest category cleanly, so she is filed as 'other'; Desmond Crisis (self-described 'digital lifestyle evangelist' / host / former game developer / otaku-community founder) was filed as 'creator' as the closest fit. Cover uses hero:0, the 'Night City Rising' key art banner (2560x961); the og:image is only a small cropped favicon, not event key art. Guest-freshness recheck (verify-06, 2026-10-05): confirmed current — a fresh re-render of the guests-of-honor page still captions every card 'BAYCON 42' and titles the page 'BayCon 2027 / Westercon 79', with no stale-year or past-edition markers. Refute-03 recheck (2026-10-05): tried to refute, upheld -- on fresh re-extraction, 3 of the 5 cards (Saulson, Marontate, Crisis) still self-caption 'BAYCON 42' directly in their own bio text (per-guest, not just page-level); Anders and Newitz sit in the same single 'Guests of Honor' grid with no competing or older-year content anywhere on the page.
